contract.application_relevance: Workers route numeric order IDs only for one hostname and a required query shape.
contract.candidate_classification: assertion-bearing ordinary API correctness candidate; no reviewed census credit yet
contract.cleanup: All URL, params, iterator, pattern, array, and result values are request-local. Return from synchronous fetch releases references. No timer, outgoing fetch, binding, durable write, object URL allocation, or retained cross-request capability. External supervisor stops only owned processes and deletes only its fresh deployment/store directory after receipt capture.
contract.desired_behavior: 2048 and full are separate named captures; nonnumeric id, wrong search key, and wrong hostname each prevent a match.
contract.distinctness: Custom regexp restriction and conjunction across components, not optional capture shape or ignoreCase.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(pattern.hasRegExpGroups, true, 'custom numeric regexp is reflected by hasRegExpGroups');
t.equal(result !== null, true, 'numeric order path matches');
t.equal(result.search.groups.view, 'full', 'separate query capture is mapped to correct component');
t.equal(pattern.exec('https://api.example.test/orders/draft?view=full'), null, 'valid URL rejected by numeric path constraint');
t.equal(pattern.test('https://api.example.test/orders/2048?mode=full'), false, 'matching path cannot override mismatching search component');
t.equal(pattern.test('https://other.example.test/orders/2048?view=full'), false, 'matching captures cannot override hostname constraint');
contract.hypothesis: Custom group metadata or group-name mapping may be lost at the host seam, or one successful component may mask another component nonmatch.
contract.mechanism: Custom regexp-group metadata and eight-component conjunction
contract.ordinary_input_scope: Successful public API calls on complete ordinary URL strings or valid property, pair, and pattern inputs. Valid URL nonmatches are intentional boolean/null outcomes, never malformed-input probes. Example domains and documentation IPv6 addresses are data only.
preconditions: Fresh isolated fixture deployment on the exact reviewed direct-celld build; external source/build/process witness required.
Global URL, URLSearchParams, and for U217-U220 URLPattern are supplied by celld, not by Node, a shim, or a mock.
External finite-deadline supervisor and owned-process cleanup are available; missing runtime prerequisites are BLOCKED.
